shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace/app 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__ 2>&1; echo "---"; cat /workspace/package.json 2>&1 | head -n 100

cat /workspace/next.config.* 2>&1; echo "---next.config---"; cat /workspace/next.config.mjs 2>&1; echo "---tsconfig---"; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json 2>&1; echo "---lib---"; ls -R /workspace/lib 2>&1 || ls -R /workspace/src 2>&1; echo "---git log---"; git log --oneline -10 2>&1; echo "---git show HEAD---"; git show HEAD --stat 2>&1
ls -la /workspace/.next 2>&1 | head; echo "---hidden---"; ls -la /workspace/.gitignore 2>&1; cat /workspace/.gitignore

grep -r "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 200
echo "---"
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | head -n 50
echo "---"
grep -r "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next --include="*.d.ts" --include="*.ts" | head -n 100

grep -rn "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" | head -n 100
echo "---"
grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts | head -n 20
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts | head -n 200

grep -rn "unstable_ViewTransition\|ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 50
echo "---config---"
grep -rn "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 50
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head -n 100 2>&1
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | grep -i view -n 2>&1

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts | sed -n '1,250p'
echo "---app-router-context---"
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-context.shared-runtime.d.ts | sed -n '1,100p'

cat /workspace/node_modules/react/index.js | head -n 100 2>&1
echo "---react types ViewTransition---"
grep -rn "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/react --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 100
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | grep -i transition 2>&1
cat /workspace/package.json 2>&1

grep -rn "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/react --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 100
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/router-transition.d.ts 2>&1
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/router-transition.js 2>&1 | head -n 200
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/view-transition* 2>&1
find /workspace/node_modules/next -name "*view*" -type f | head -n 20

grep -rn "experimental.*viewTransition\|viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist --include="*.js" | head -n 20
echo "---types react---"
cat /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts 2>&1 | grep -n "ViewTransition\|TransitionType" | head
cat /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" | head -n 20
grep -rn "view-transition" /workspace --include="*.css" | head

cat /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | grep -o "ViewTransition" | wc -l; grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head
node -e "import('react').then(m=>console.log(Object.keys(m)))" 2>&1
echo "---check types---"
ls /workspace/node_modules/react/*.d.ts 2>&1 | head
cat /workspace/node_modules/react/index.d.ts 2>&1 | grep -n "ViewTransition" | head

ls /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/ | head -n 20
grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react --include="*.d.ts" | head
node -e "console.log(require('react').version)" 2>&1
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/view-transition.js 2>&1 | head -n 200
find /workspace/node_modules/next -type f -name "*.js" | xargs grep -l "ViewTransition" 2>&1 | head

cat /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | sed -n '2000,2100p'
echo "---exp---"
cat /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts | sed -n '130,300p'
echo "---react exp compiled---"
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/ | head -n 20
grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js | head -n 20

grep -n "addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js | head
grep -n "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md | head
# Check if Next provides compiled react that includes ViewTransition but the installed react (19.1) doesn't - next might be using its own compiled version
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/ 2>&1 | head
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/node_modules 2>&1 | head
cat /workspace/node_modules/react/package.json | grep version

cat /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | grep -n "addTransitionType" | head
grep -n "addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head
# Try to understand how ViewTransition works with React 19.1 - maybe need to upgrade react or still usable via next's compiled react
cat /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | wc -l
grep -n "ViewTransition\|REACT_VIEW" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head
cat /workspace/next.config.ts
# Check if there is experimental flag
grep -r "viewTransition\|experimental" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | grep -i "unstable\|view" | head -n 20

sed -n '2090,2120p' /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts
echo "---"
node -e "const r = require('/workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js'); console.log('ViewTransition' in r, typeof r.ViewTransition, r.addTransitionType)" 2>&1
# check react 19.1 experimental exports
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js | grep -n "addTransitionType" | head -n 5
cat /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.react-server.development.js | grep -n "ViewTransition" | head 2>&1

find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist -type f -name "*.js" | xargs grep -l "unstable_ViewTransition\|ViewTransition" 2>/dev/null | head -n 10
echo "---next compiled react version---"
grep -r "react" /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | grep -i react | head
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ 2>&1 | head
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/ | head -n 30
grep -r "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist --include="*.js" 2>/dev/null | wc -l
# check what Next expects for viewTransition
grep -rn "view-transition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md 2>&1 | head
# Try building with current React version to see error
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -n 100

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/generated-plugin-options.d.ts 2>&1 | head -n 20
grep -rn '"viewTransition' /workspace/node_modules/next --include="*.json" | head
grep -rn "viewTransitions" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js 2>&1 | head
grep -rn "experimental.*view" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 20

npm view react versions --json 2>&1 | tail -n 100
echo "---"
npm view react dist-tags 2>&1 | head -n 20

npm install react@19.3.1 react-dom@19.3.1 --save 2>&1 | tail -n 20
echo "---done---"
node -e "console.log(require('react').version); console.log(typeof require('react').ViewTransition)" 2>&1

node -e "import('react').then(m=>console.log(Object.keys(m).filter(k=>k.toLowerCase().includes('view') || k.toLowerCase().includes('transition'))))" 2>&1
echo "---"
node -e "console.log(require('react').ViewTransition); console.log(require('react').addTransitionType)" 2>&1
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -n 100

cat /workspace/package.json | grep react
echo "---check files include ViewTransition---"
grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/app --include="*.tsx"
echo "---check css---"
grep -n "view-transition" /workspace/app/globals.css
echo "---check transitionTypes---"
grep -rn "transitionTypes" /workspace/app --include="*.tsx"
